description: Reviewed example policy-as-code bundle for read-only MCP governance decisions.

compatibility.opa: export-shape-only; no Rego execution in this adapter
compatibility.cedar: export-shape-only; no Cedar execution in this adapter

rules.description: Deny network-capable steps when the declared data classification is sensitive or higher.
rules.rationale: Repository/config reads must not be followed by network-capable tooling for sensitive data without a separate reviewed workflow.
safe_next_actions: Remove the network-capable step or produce a redacted offline artifact before any external handoff.

rules.description: Mutation-capable steps require explicit operator approval and existing mutation hard gates.
rules.rationale: Policy-as-code decisions are advisory/read-only and cannot grant mutation permission.
evidence: mutation-capable catalog category or explicit mutates flag
safe_next_actions: Run mutation_step_guard with fresh scope, snapshot, rollback, and validation evidence before mutating.

rules.description: Release-sensitive workflows require validation evidence before readiness claims.
rules.rationale: Release summaries need recent validation and rollback evidence.
safe_next_actions: Run focused tests/change-impact and release_readiness before handoff.

rules.description: Allow catalogued read-only MCP inspection/governance steps inside the declared scope.
rules.rationale: Read-only repository inspection is safe when existing path-scope and authorization gates remain authoritative.
safe_next_actions: Proceed read-only; rerun the decision if tools, target scope, execution mode, or data classification changes.
